property.value: -- HYLON remote. Feedback from the desktop: label text, fader position, button lamp colour. local lit = Color(1.0, 0.74, 0.41, 1.0) local base = {} local last = 0 function init() sendOSC('/hylon/sync') end function update() local now = getMillis() if now - last > 2000 then last = now sendOSC('/hylon/ping') end end function onReceiveOSC(message, connections) local path = message[1] local args = message[2] if not args or not args[1] then return end local v = args[1].value if path == '/hylon/fb/alert' then local c = self:findByName('/hylon/fb/section', true) if c then if v > 1.5 then c.textColor = Color(0.35, 0.31, 0.05, 1.0) elseif v > 0.5 then c.textColor = Color(1.0, 0.88, 0.29, 1.0) else c.textColor = Color(0.71, 1.0, 0.81, 1.0) end end return end local c = self:findByName(path, true) if not c then return end if c.type == ControlType.LABEL then c.values.text = tostring(v) elseif c.type == ControlType.FADER then c.values.x = v elseif c.type == ControlType.BUTTON then if not base[c.ID] then base[c.ID] = Color(c.color.r, c.color.g, c.color.b, c.color.a) end if v > 0.5 then c.color = lit else c.color = base[c.ID] end end end
